Week by week: 21 Oct to 15 Nov 2026

Fixed to 21 Oct–15 Nov, all ads; not changed by the filters above. Spend and platform figures are Meta "Amount spent" etc. Orders and revenue are all GoKwik confirmed orders with a Facebook or Instagram UTM, matched to stage by utm_campaign (stage taken from the campaign name). Orders with no usable campaign in the UTM are shown as Unmatched. Cost / order is spend divided by GoKwik orders.

% split by stage: 13 to 15 Nov 2026

Fixed to 13–15 Nov, all ads; not changed by the filters above. Spend, impressions, clicks and purchases are Meta "Amount spent" and platform figures. Orders and revenue are GoKwik confirmed orders with a Facebook or Instagram UTM, matched to stage by utm_campaign; orders with no campaign are left out of the stage rows and shown in the total. ROAS is revenue divided by spend.

Creatives (ads) by spend
Top 40 rows by spend in the current filters. Click a column heading to sort. Purchases are as reported by Meta and will not match GoKwik confirmed orders. Revenue is GoKwik confirmed order value for orders with a Facebook or Instagram UTM. Orders whose campaign can't be matched are split across stages by spend share. ROAS is revenue divided by spend.
